{
  "description": "A family-aware diagnostic adapter for Self-EvolveRec that measures the trained GRU4Rec model through the host ModelView interface and turns measured results into an interpretation prompt.",
  "motivation": "Provide actionable evidence for model improvements while preserving the benchmark, single-model constraint, and distinction between observable data and unavailable user traits.",
  "implementation_notes": "Retain DiagnosisProbe(view, device), run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), and diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis). Return metrics with explicit definitions and measurement counts. Use the actual trained view.model and preserve item_emb, log2feats(sequence), and predict_score(features, items). Handle B x L batches and left padding correctly: sequence readout uses the final nonpadding position, never count-1. Mask padding and invalid targets in diagnostics. Use only public histories, titles, descriptions, and timestamps; do not infer unavailable ratings, reviews, or simulator traits. Produce full-catalog unseen-item recommendations for twenty real training users, five per category. Keep one independently trained model per category and consistent checkpoint/predictor architectures. Model selection remains the host's macro-average validation HR@10.",
  "pseudocode": "class DiagnosisProbe(view, device):
  run_full_diagnosis(train_loader):
    save model training state; switch to evaluation mode
    initialize metric accumulators and definitions
    without gradients:
      for (_, sequence, positive, negative) in train_loader:
        features = view.log2feats(sequence)
        identify valid nonpadding prediction targets
        score targets through view.predict_score
        accumulate defined predictive diagnostics over valid targets
      for each of five designated training users per category:
        encode the user's left-padded public history
        select the final nonpadding feature when features are positional
        score the catalog using that category's single trained model
        exclude padding and previously seen items
        collect recommendations and defined recommendation diagnostics
    restore model training state
    return {metrics, metric_definitions}

diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis):
  serialize measured metrics and their definitions
  request evidence-grounded interpretation and GRU4Rec-compatible improvements
  distinguish measurements, hypotheses, and unavailable information",
  "originality": {
    "score": 4,
    "positive": "Connects native diagnostic interpretation to explicit family-specific interfaces and benchmark constraints.",
    "negative": "Primarily an integration specification; it introduces no new diagnostic estimator or learning algorithm."
  },
  "future_potential": {
    "score": 7,
    "positive": "Could support reproducible, evidence-guided architecture and optimization changes across sequential model families.",
    "negative": "Its usefulness depends on well-defined probes; training diagnostics alone do not establish validation improvement."
  },
  "code_difficulty": {
    "score": 5,
    "positive": "The required API and batch format are explicit, and existing model interfaces can supply representations and scores.",
    "negative": "Correct padding, target alignment, catalog filtering, efficient scoring, and architecture compatibility require careful implementation."
  }
}
